verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies this workflow: the agent can operate the terminal and run commands, which could cover git, and Projects natively support Git worktrees, which shows some git integration. Nothing documents staging, commit-message generation, branch creation, or pull requests as agent features. missing for 10: explicit docs on staging and committing, AI-written commit messages, branch creation, opening PRs on GitHub or other hosts, independent or hands-on confirmation.
